messages:
emma-partnerops: quick note 1: We're seeing marketplace + hardware-bundle leads get double-booked between AEs and SIs. Need a concise routing rule.
raj-sales-eu: yup — marketplace deals often include a certified SI SKU; that should influence ownership.
sophia-si-manager: suggestion: introduce `co_sell_path` enum on SFDC and a small decision matrix. if `co_sell_path` == `marketplace_certified` or `hw_bundle` AND SI has certification -> SI primary. otherwise redwood-led.
mike-revops: i can add the field. values: marketplace_certified, hw_bundle, referral, redwood_led, partner_initiated. add `si_primary` boolean computed by workflow.
lina-ps: SLAs: SI gets 24h to acknowledge marketplace intro. if no ack, AE gets temporary ownership and schedules next steps. keeps momentum.
emma-partnerops: agreed. also add "joint-credits" rule: if deal > $200k and SI performed implementation estimate > 20% of TCV, record as joint credit for pipeline attribution.
raj-sales-eu: we need to protect strategic small deals too. add manager override flow: AE files `co_sell_override` case with brief rationale; partnerops reviews within 36h.
sophia-si-manager: dispute flow: raise in #partnerships with tag `@emma-partnerops @vp-partnerships`. 48h decision window, otherwise default to redwood-led to avoid stalling the customer.
ops-bot: automation note: when `co_sell_path` set to `marketplace_certified`, create task: "SI Intro + Cert Check" assigned to `si_owner`.
mike-revops: sample SFDC automation snippet (for revops):
```
trigger: on update co_sell_path
if co_sell_path in [marketplace_certified, hw_bundle] and si_certified == true:
  set si_primary = true
  create task "SI Intro + Cert Check" assign si_owner
else:
  set si_primary = false
```
lina-ps: handoff email template (short):
"Hi <Customer> — copying <SI lead> and <Redwood AE>. We'd like to schedule a 30m joint scoping call to confirm integration and HW timeline. Are any of these times good?"
emma-partnerops: privacy/legal exception: if customer has strict procurement rules we can deviate from timing rules; tag `PRIORITY_PROCUREMENT` and partnerops will triage.
raj-sales-eu: action items: revops to add field + automation (mike), partnerops to publish 1-pager + decision matrix (emma), SI to confirm certification roster (sophia).
sophia-si-manager: i'll publish roster by EOD tomorrow.
mike-revops: i'll provision the fields and basic workflow today, ETA 12h.
emma-partnerops: i'll draft the one-pager and post in #partnerships for feedback. target 3/22.
lina-ps: i'll update sales playbook with the new sample email and escalation steps.
vp-partnerships: thanks team 1: this should reduce friction. keep me posted if any partner pushes back; we'll escalate. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: created task "Add co_sell_path field + automation" assigned to mike-revops due 1768709856.
